content_of_post_to_answer: Can a person remain happy even when their body is failing them?
answer: A failing body and a failing life are not the same thing. Illness can shrink what a person is able to do, but it does not automatically erase curiosity, connection, humor, love, or a sense of meaning. The difficult part is grieving the abilities that are lost while still noticing the parts of life that remain available. Happiness in such situations is often not about feeling good despite the body; it is about no longer measuring the whole value of life by what the body can produce.
